notes:
**The Opening Range Breakout template had never fired. Not once, for anybody.** It sealed the range on a candle stamped exactly 9:29 - and there is no 9:29 candle on a five-minute chart, or fifteen, or hourly. Only a one-minute one has it. So anyone who picked the app's own ORB template at the default candle size got a report saying "0 trades", which reads as a verdict on the idea. The range is sealed by the first candle past 9:30 now, and a test runs the template at all five candle sizes.

**On an Upstox account the opening range ran until three in the afternoon.** The two brokers stamp their candles differently - Dhan in local time, Upstox in UTC - and four places in the rule engine read the clock straight off the candle. So "before 9:30" stayed true until 14:59 in Mumbai, and "buy after 9:30" first became true at 3pm. There is one conversion now and it is correct for both brokers and for a phone in any timezone.

**Thirteen new tests build the same session twice, once with each broker's stamp, and demand the same answer from both.**
